title: Code and results for "Sensor-error-aware ice routing using shipborne imagery and AMSR2: a simulation study based on Polarstern cruise PS131"
description: Python code and result tables for the paper. Camera frames of Polarstern cruise PS131 are matched to bridge observations, AMSR2 ASI sea ice concentration and ERA5; ice classifiers (camera, AMSR2, early fusion) are evaluated by cross-validation over hourly episodes; their measured errors drive a routing simulation that compares planners using hard labels, expected cost and a cell-wise CVaR surrogate, with AMSR2-based and DMI ice chart references, and a residual PPO agent.
